Visitor skips form elements entirely

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_form(self, ctx, action_url, method):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return "skip"
    html = '<p>Before form</p><form><input type="email" name="email"></form><p>After form</p>'
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
